name: Children’s Tylenol® Oral Suspension – Acetaminophen 160 mg/5 mL, 120 mL Bottle
description:
Effective Relief Tailored for Children

Children’s Tylenol® Oral Suspension is designed to provide fast and effective relief for children experiencing fever and mild to moderate pain. With its trusted acetaminophen formula—160 mg per 5 mL—this oral suspension offers a gentle yet reliable solution for common symptoms like sore throats, headaches, and minor aches associated with colds or flu. Parents can feel confident knowing this product is specifically crafted for the delicate needs of children. The 120 mL bottle provides plenty of doses to keep comfort within reach.

Easy-to-Use Formula with a Kid-Friendly Taste

Administering medication to children can be challenging, but Children’s Tylenol® Oral Suspension makes it easier. The liquid suspension comes with a child-approved taste that minimizes resistance. Measuring is simple and precise, thanks to the included dosing cup, helping parents ensure their child receives just the right amount every time. The format is ideal for children who may have difficulty swallowing tablets, making dosing stress-free for both parents and kids.

Safe and Trusted Brand for Over 60 Years

For decades, Tylenol® has been a trusted household name in pain and fever relief, offering formulations that prioritize safety and effectiveness. This children’s version adheres to strict quality standards, providing peace of mind to caregivers. It is free from ibuprofen, alcohol, and artificial dyes, reducing the likelihood of unwanted reactions. Always follow the label’s guidance and your healthcare provider’s recommendations for safe usage tailored to your child’s age and weight.
